name: io.github.anrysys/tg-ai
description: Local MCP server that lets an AI agent drive your personal Telegram account over MTProto: send as you, read replies, full-text search your whole chat history in PostgreSQL, and draft replies in your own per-chat writing style. Anti-ban guardrails built in.

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: PostgreSQL connection string for the local archive

environmentVariables.name: TG_SESSION_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Base name of the Telethon session file

environmentVariables.name: TG_EXPECTED_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Optional guard: warn if the logged-in account is not this username
